d: Iran is escalating its attacks across the Gulf, targeting US military assets in Bahrain and Kuwait after fresh American strikes on an Iranian missile launch site. Tehran claims to have destroyed key radar systems and other American assets, as tensions rise around the Strait of Hormuz and Washington reinforces its military presence. Meanwhile, Iranian state broadcaster IRIB has released rare footage purportedly showing the moment an American F-15E Strike Eagle was hit by Iranian air defences, seven months after it was shot down.
